card.name: Clinical trial descriptions in warnings
card.fires_on: Linking words inside trial summaries, mostly "of" in "lack of efficacy", also "the" in a trial name and "disease" in "coronary heart disease". It is strongest in warnings about heart failure and cardiovascular trials.
